name: Shoham
overview: Shoham is a male member of the tribe of Levi, specifically identified as a Merarite, descending from Merari son of Levi. He is uniquely noted as the son of Jaaziah, situating him within the Levitical family lines responsible for temple service. His role is tied to the Levitical divisions outlined in 1 Chronicles 24:27.
namesAndTitles: The name Shoham means 'carnelian,' a precious stone, reflecting a proper name recorded in Scripture without indication that it was given directly by God. This name emphasizes the value and distinct identity of the individual within the Levitical context.
familyAndRelationships: Shoham is explicitly recorded as the son of Jaaziah, establishing his immediate paternal lineage. Scripture does not provide further family relationships beyond this connection within the Levitical tribe.
scriptureSignificance: Shoham's significance lies in his identification as a Levitical descendant through Jaaziah, linking him to the Merarite branch of Levi. This connection situates him within the organized priestly and temple service structure established in Israel. His mention in 1 Chronicles 24:27 highlights the detailed genealogical records God inspired to preserve the order of worship and service in the sanctuary.
